title: A Stacks-defined left derived value is a pointwise Kan-extension value
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ and $\mathcal D'$ be categories, let $S$ be a right multiplicative system of arrows of $\mathcal D$ (Stacks Categories Definition Tag 04VC: (RMS1) identities lie in $S$ and $S$ is closed under composition; (RMS2) for $s:Y\to W$ in $S$ and any $f:Z\to W$ there are $t:V\to Z$ in $S$ and $g:V\to Y$ with $f\circ t=s\circ g$; (RMS3) if $f,g:X_1\to Y$ and $s\in S$ with source $Y$ satisfy $s\circ f=s\circ g$, then there is $t\in S$ with target $X_1$ and $f\circ t=g\circ t$), let $Q:\mathcal D\to S^{-1}\mathcal D$ be the localization of $\mathcal D$ at $S$ (the right localization, as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]), and let $F:\mathcal D\to\mathcal D'$ be a functor. (This covers Stacks Situation Tag 05S8, with $\mathcal D,\mathcal D'$ triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category] and $F$ exact, since the multiplicative system $S$ there is in particular a right multiplicative system.) Let $X$ be an object of $\mathcal D$ and $Y$ an object of $\mathcal D'$. Let $S/X$ be the cofiltered category of arrows $s:X'\to X$ in $S$, with morphisms the commuting triangles (Stacks Remark Tag 05Q4). Suppose the left derived functor of $F$ is defined at $X$ with value $Y$ in the sense of Stacks Definition Tag 05S9, i.e. the pro-object $G:S/X\to\mathcal D'$, $(s:X'\to X)\mapsto F(X')$, is essentially constant with value $Y$ [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram], with cone $u_s:Y\to F(X')$. Then $F$ has a pointwise right Kan extension along $Q$ at $QX$ with value $Y$: the functor $(X',\varphi)\mapsto F(X')$ on the structured-arrow category of pairs $(X',\ \varphi:QX\to QX')$ (a morphism $(X',\varphi)\to(X'',\psi)$ being an arrow $a:X'\to X''$ of $\mathcal D$ with $Q(a)\circ\varphi=\psi$) has a limit, and it has a limit cone with vertex $Y$ whose projection at $(X',Q(s)^{-1})$ is $u_s$ for every object $s:X'\to X$ of $S/X$. In particular the projection at $(X,\mathrm{id}_{QX})$ is $u_{\mathrm{id}_X}:Y\to F(X)$, the canonical comparison map of Definition 05S9.

source.place: Definition Tag 05S9 (definition-derived-functor) together with Lemma Tag 05SA (lemma-derived-functor) and the pointwise reformulation in Situation Tag 05S8

proof.text: Write $J=S/X$ (cofiltered by Stacks Remark 05Q4) and $G:J\to\mathcal D'$, $s\mapsto F(X')$. The hypothesis [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram] gives a cone $u_j:Y\to G(j)$, an index $j_0$, and $r:G(j_0)\to Y$ with $r\circ u_{j_0}=\mathrm{id}_Y$, such that for every $j$ there are $a:k\to j_0$ and $b:k\to j$ with $G(b)=u_j\circ r\circ G(a)$. This cone is a limit cone of $G$: given a cone $v_j:Z\to G(j)$, put $w=r\circ v_{j_0}$; for any $j$, with $a,b$ as above, $v_j=G(b)\circ v_k=u_j\circ r\circ G(a)\circ v_k=u_j\circ r\circ v_{j_0}=u_j\circ w$; and if $w'$ also satisfies $u_j\circ w'=v_j$ for all $j$, then $w'=r\circ u_{j_0}\circ w'=r\circ v_{j_0}=w$ (Stacks Categories Lemma Tag 0G2V).

source.place: Definition Tag 05S9 and Categories Definition Tag 05PU(2)

proof.text: Let $K$ be the structured-arrow category of pairs $(X',\varphi:QX\to QX')$ and $\iota:J\to K$, $(s:X'\to X)\mapsto(X',Q(s)^{-1})$, sending a triangle $t\circ a=s$ to $a$ (a morphism of $K$, since $Q(t)\circ Q(a)=Q(s)$ gives $Q(a)\circ Q(s)^{-1}=Q(t)^{-1}$); then $(F\circ\mathrm{proj})\circ\iota=G$. We show $\iota$ is initial (Stacks Categories Definition Tag 09WP). Fix an object $(X',\varphi)$ of $K$. A morphism $\iota(s)\to(X',\varphi)$, for $s:P\to X$, is an arrow $g:P\to X'$ with $Q(g)\circ Q(s)^{-1}=\varphi$, and the morphisms of the comma category $\iota/(X',\varphi)$ are the arrows $a$ of $J$ with $g'\circ a=g$. Apply [lem-pc-right-localization-hom-colimit] with $M=X$, $N=X'$: the map $\varinjlim_{J^{\mathrm{opp}}}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(P,X')\to\operatorname{Hom}(QX,QX')$, $g\mapsto Q(g)\circ Q(s)^{-1}$, is bijective. Surjectivity gives an object of $\iota/(X',\varphi)$. The colimit of sets is the disjoint union of the $\operatorname{Hom}(P,X')$ modulo the equivalence relation generated by $g'\sim g'\circ a$ for $a$ an arrow of $J$; so by injectivity any two objects $(s,g)$, $(s',g')$ of $\iota/(X',\varphi)$ are joined by a zigzag of such identifications, each intermediate element mapping to $\varphi$ by compatibility of the map, i.e. by a zigzag in $\iota/(X',\varphi)$. Hence $\iota$ is initial, and by Stacks Categories Lemma Tag 002R (Mathlib `CategoryTheory.Functor.Initial.hasLimit_of_comp` and `Functor.Initial.isLimitExtendConeEquiv`) the limit cone of Step 1 extends to a limit cone of $F\circ\mathrm{proj}$ over $K$ with vertex $Y$, whose projection at $(X',\varphi)$ is $F(g)\circ u_s$ for any object $(s,g)$ of $\iota/(X',\varphi)$. So $F$ has a pointwise right Kan extension along $Q$ at $QX$ with value $Y$.

source.place: Remark Tag 05Q4, Definition Tag 09WP, Lemma Tag 002R

proof.text: For an object $s:X'\to X$ of $J$, the pair $(s,\mathrm{id}_{X'})$ is an object of $\iota/(X',Q(s)^{-1})$, so the projection of the extended cone at $(X',Q(s)^{-1})$ is $u_s$. Since $Q(\mathrm{id}_X)^{-1}=\mathrm{id}_{QX}$, the object $(X,\mathrm{id}_{QX})$ is $\iota(\mathrm{id}_X)$, and its projection is $u_{\mathrm{id}_X}:Y\to F(X)$, the canonical map of Definition 05S9 (the cone leg of the essentially constant pro-object at the identity denominator).
